Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage
          `-- Keep workspace and controller ownership; replace obsolete DiagramService wiring with issued-revision retention and add CanvasView and compact-read access under the session.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Reorganize the mutation boundary around default buffered exec batches, optional immediate edits, and atomic supplied-diagram batches; the per-call-only flow no longer explains it.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Add named CanvasView checkpoints, working copies, generation results, pinned revision dependencies, and current-only exports to its existing history ownership.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Replace the sole-content-writer account with pure revision operations, explicit retention, separate generation, and controller publication; preserve immutable revision identities.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Distinguish attachment-scoped uploads, durable AgentContextLibrary records, and diagram-owned context preparation before generated or supplied edits; the single uploaded-context flow is no longer sufficient.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
          `-- Include supplied submissions, variant or creation results, and application receipts while retaining retry and cancellation states.
      `-- [2] Add: Saved and diagram-owned AgentContexts
          `-- Develop the overview's AgentContextLibrary and diagram-context components: durable records and prepared source evidence remain distinct from uploaded trajectories.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Regroup the expanded surface around bound AgentChat tools, compact reads, buffered or immediate exec, diagram batches, CanvasViews, and generation routes; retain live, proposal, and persistence interfaces.
      |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Show AgentChatService owning turns and tools, AgentDiagrammingSessionService owning canvas API calls, and their bindings, batch service, generation bridge, and browser dispatch at separate boundaries.
      |-- [2] Add: Bound reads, buffered execution and receipts
          `-- Develop AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec: turn-bound attachment, read aliases, read-triggered flushes, one receipt per committed batch, and uncertain-outcome retries.
      `-- [2] Add: Supplied diagram batch application
          `-- Develop the overview's DiagramBatchService: validate or generate operations against one snapshot, then publish them through one guarded application and undo checkpoint.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          `-- Add FileChatStore transcripts and durable saved AgentContexts; place CanvasView and generation checkpoint references in workspace history, not catalog publication.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
      `-- [1a] Correct: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
          `-- Replace the unconditional per-call exec claim with default buffered batches and optional immediate edits; each dispatched controller transaction remains isolated in the proposal.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Include CanvasView metadata, pinned revisions, and generation-result checkpoints in controller-to-record batches; autosave still does not publish catalog revisions.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
          `-- Add a Managed generation component under alternatives: pin one saved parent checkpoint, create child views without switching the active view, and retain each result or terminal status. Attach generation detail here.
  |-- Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2  existing canvas
      `-- [1a] Correct: 4 FROM SUPPLIED EDIT TO SAVED CANVAS
          `-- Insert DiagramBatchService between ChatDiagramTools submission and controller publication: supplied operations share one snapshot and commit together; single generated edits remain separate.
  |-- [3] AgentChat conversations and canvas bindings  new canvas
      |-- AgentChatService turn lifecycle
          `-- Show Codex connection, turn events, approvals, interruption, and transcript updates under AgentChatService ownership.
      |-- ChatDiagramTools and bound canvas access
          `-- Show turn-scoped MCP bindings, selected references, and supplied-edit preparation calling AgentDiagrammingSessionService; connect from AgentChatService in the Mapping backend overview.
      `-- Chat persistence and resumption
          `-- Show FileChatStore, imported threads, tool reload, and retained child-chat records without treating chat history as canvas history.
  `-- [3] Managed canvas generation  new canvas
      |-- Generation orchestration
          `-- Show AgentChatService pinning a saved CanvasView and starting parallel child chats; connect from Managed generation in Saved CanvasViews and branching.
      |-- Isolated child canvases
          `-- Show GenerationCanvasBridge binding each child to its own controller and history, away from the parent canvas.
      `-- Settlement and publication
          `-- Show cancellation, retained results, and idempotent synchronization into child CanvasView checkpoints; connect to CanvasHistoryService in the canvas domain model.
